GTA VI review copies are apparently watermarked, with the reviewer's name flashing on the screen to prevent leaks as Rockstar is spooked
items.description: The GTA 6 leaks really spooked Rockstar. The review copies apparently are watermarked, with the reviewer's name flashing on the screen to prevent leaks. This way if anyone leaks footage, Rockstar knows exactly what copy it came from and that reviewer/outlet becomes eternally blacklisted from all future Rockstar releases. Source: https://twitterviewer.net/ManaByte/status/2115139188009922730 submitted by /u/Gyatto- [link] [comments]
